The World of Immortals is the world every mortal longs for. For many, it is an eternal glory to cause a spatial distortion and enter the World of Immortals. But the vicissitude of time is simply merciless; the legends regarding immortality had long been forgotten.
However, a miracle shall rise once more! An immortal was about to split the space with martial arts and cut all ties with the mortal world. The protagonist, Xiao Chen, was caught up in it and accidentally brought to the World of Immortals. What will they find in the vast world beyond the rift?

1761.synopsis:

2017.synopsis:
The story is about Toru, an extremely quiet and shy high school student who has a crush on Ryoji, a popular member of the high school swimming team known for his s*xual escapades. Further complicating this matter is that Toru and Ryoji are very close friends, thus forcing Toru to hide his real feelings for Ryoji and pretend to be just one of his good friends, while being torn between his love for Ryoji and the facade he has to keep up when he sees him every day.
But all that changes one day when Ryoji makes an indecent proposal to Toru, asking him if he would like to experiment with him sexually, and admitting that he had been aroused by thoughts of him during s*xual interc**rse with his girlfriend. Toru unhappily accepts, pressured by his feelings for Ryoji, but as time passes Toru becomes even more aggravated as he realizes that his s*xual affair with Ryoji was just a fling based on Ryoji’s s*xual curiosity, and not on actual romantic attraction.
Toru is so depressed about the one-sided situation between him and Ryoji that he confides with a close friend named Kashiwazaki about his emotional turmoil. 4577.synopsis:
Long ago, there were people who stood upon the earth with their heads held high. They never bowed to anyone because of their indomitable spirit. They were capable of controlling wind and lightning, and conquering dragons and serpents. They seemed strong enough to split the earth and shatter the stars with their fists. They traveled throughout the land and called themselves Magi. Eventually, one of them would become a Supreme Magus! These men are the ancestors of human beings. Their blood is what we all share today.
Qing Long is the former strongest man in the world. He traveled through space and time and was reborn as Ji Hao in the Fire Crow Clan of the Southern Wasteland. It’s a complicated world. Forces from both inside and outside of the clan want this young and talented boy to die. Under great pressure, Ji Hao makes a deal with a mysterious man, who resides in his spiritual space, never showing his real face. He gains two drops of blood from a dragon and phoenix. Afterwards, Ji Hao becomes increasingly more powerful.

4833.synopsis:
Toaru Jihanki no Fanfare is a Toaru Kagaku no Railgun mini-novel by the author of the Baccano! and Durarara!! series, Narita Ryohgo. It was included with the special edition of the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun Manga Volume 05 as part of the Pseudepigrapha Railgun artbook.

13281.synopsis:
There was once a hero.
Unique black hair. Excellent eyes. Contrary to his delicate features, he who had abnormal strength was called the Otherworldy Hero.
At the hero’s long adventure (up to the point where his wooden sword that had been kindly granted to him by the king was replaced by the holy sword blessed by the holy maiden) he saved the prince that had been kidnapped by the demon king, and so the kingdom was swept by worry.
The hero’s strength that could fell the demon king was deemed too dangerous to leave unrestrained.
One advisor spoke up. Why not marry him to royalty?
The king thought that was a viable option. Family, to an alien from another world would be the best of chains. There was one problem. The king was abundantly blessed with sons and had princes galore, but not a single daughter.
Ho, and it wasn’t like I could marry off two boys.
At a burst of inspiration the king slapped his knee.
That was it!
You just had to turn a prince into a princess!
And so the hero ended up in a position to be marrying a man.
This story, is a tale of the aforementioned otherworldly hero, and his bride, the former-prince-now-princess and their ridiculously hilarious marriage.

16609.synopsis:
A great war raged between cultivators a hundred thousand years ago. Immortals fell by the tens of thousands, the path of cultivation itself was severed, and after the dust settled, tombs forested the world.
A hundred thousand years after the last legend faded, Lu Yun, commandant of tomb raiders, descends upon the world. Armed with the Tome of Life and Death, he has some burning questions to answer.
……
“This isn’t how you raid a tomb!” Lu Yun smirked at the cultivators frantically scurrying about the ancient tomb. “Do you want me to teach you?”
……
But ah, can someone teach him how to cure his new body’s erectile dysfunction?

19937.synopsis:
In his past lifetime, he was an exceptional prodigy who practiced both medicine and martial arts. In this lifetime, on earth, he used his superb medical expertise and extreme martial arts achievements from his past lifetime to excel in the medical field and the ancient martial arts world. He moved his way towards the pinnacle! 
A fine youngster, who had been frequently looked down upon due to his poverty, had gone through the cold and warmth of this world to lament laughingly that life was merely so. However, he accidentally awakened the memory of his past lifetime. Since then, for three incarnations, he enjoyed prosperity.

20193.synopsis:
Yo, Hi! I’m Frank, I made a deal with a demon to pay me some money for receiving a guest for a few days every week.
I had no idea about what I have done.
On May 1st, Conan ‘the God of Death’ came to my house. I was forced to let him in and we get involved in a criminal case.
On May 8th, Bruce Wayne ‘Batman’ came to me. I was forced to follow him to fight crime.
On May 16th, Hannibal Lecter, The Silence of the Lambs, came to my home. I can only say that I really can’t stand my guests.

20705.synopsis:
She was the realm’s cultivation* prodigy and owner of the amethyst sea. It is said that one who possesses the amethyst sea can control the six realms. Pursued and envied by the high gods of all realms, her spirit was s**ked into the black hole. There she entered the sixth daughter of the Ye family’s body, one of the four major clans of Lingwu. She could speak at five months old, walk at six months old, read at seven months old, and finished the entire Ye family’s library collection at six years old. However, the clan abandoned her when she was unable to cope with the toxic poison within her body blocking her qi* flow hence incapable to absorb cultivate or cultivate fighting energy. Following the downfall of her parents, the poison spread and she perished. Her spirit then became joined together with the cultivated prodigy.
When two spirits are joined together, what kind of tides will the appearance of this new Zi Luo bring? What type of attitude will she have when standing on top of the six realms?

20961.synopsis:
The antique market that is filled with treasures and tr*sh.

21217.synopsis: It was a time where demons roamed the earth and chaos reigned. The story took place in Luoyang, the legendary capital of the times. During the night, one could find people holding on to their food with dear lives as they faced off against stray dogs, people with weapons in hand vowing to fight against Fate to their very last breath. There was bloodshed everywhere as some died meaningless deaths, while the strong tyrannized the weak and the truth was frequently hidden. Some of the citizens had completely lost their mind, while some died on their travels. Most importantly, the words of a certain youth caused much panic in the human world. It was a time of little warmth as nights in the capital were frequently accompanied by gusts of wind and rain, and it would be covered with snow during winter. Such were the days…

21473.synopsis:
This is a story about a legend, a legend of one that should never be forgotten.
Summer, first time down the mountains in 16 years, after being raised by his 3 masters and Fairy sister.
‘Why won’t you follow the Rules of society?’
[The rules are the tool made by the strong, so I follow my own rules.]
‘Why won’t you just use your brain instead of your brawn?’
[Idiot! Have you ever seen anyone use their brain, to get back at an ant that bites them!? No, they just casually step on it.]
‘Everyone says I’m a first-class beauty!’
[Ugly, You’re not even qualified to be my maid. Only a ‘Summer certified beauty’ is worthy enough!]

“I am Summer in the spring, the autumn, and the winter, I am the world’s first above the heavens!”
Follow me, Summer Day as I step by step become formally known as the world’s first master, the world’s first doctor, the world’s richest man…… a lot of other world’s number one, but most importantly, The worlds happiest man.

21985.synopsis:
The ending of fairy tales is usually a happy ending for the hero and heroine. As for the supporting characters, who will care about their happiness? They turn dark the next day after having such a bad thought. They want to revolt, and they don’t want to be the main couple’s stepping stone to their “true love” again. Oh my god! What about the plot? What kind of story will play out with a character like this? Can it still run smoothly? The hero and heroine are going to be crippled by the supporting character!!!! Well, there’s actually a project to save the plot from it. By nipping the bud of all evil thoughts from them, they let the hero and heroine live together in happiness. The title of this project is “To Save the Supporting Character.” All executors must dutifully do their work, and as for the means to achieve it, Oh, no! That’s not worth mentioning.
 
No matter whether it is a white cat or a black cat, if that cat can catch a mouse, then it is a good cat.

22241.synopsis:
The reborn Xie Tingyue has a solemn expression on his face, holding on to the [The Great Power of Economy], the book that has always been by his side and had no known origins.
Goal: Shun down all kinds of swords and shadows, protect himself, protect his brother, and protect his useless disabled husband.
Husband: The last three words, are you sure?
—————–
The MC was reborn, coming back on the day of his wedding with the ML. In his first life, he had been badly tricked by his stepmother and ended up not getting married, and had lived a horrible life thereafter. Now that he had gotten a second chance of life, he intended to stick with the ML in the hope of saving himself and his beloved brother… (and give some face-slapping and revenge in between.)

23009.synopsis: Navier was the perfect empress, however, the Emperor wanted a wife, not a colleague. And so, the Emperor abandoned Empress Navier and placed an ens*aved girl beside him. 24289.synopsis:
Hari, who died in an unexpected car accident, had come to her senses after being reincarnated into a completely different world. Am I the daughter of the Emperor? Or the Duke’s daughter? Hari, who opened her eyes with a throbbing heart, was in shock. I’m a dog? A dog that can talk, too? And it gets worse! I was the hunting dog of a cruel emperor who exterminated his own relatives to ascend to the throne.
Now that it’s done, I have to find a way to live. The only thing this little doggy could do with her body was…
“I’ll pay you back if you raise me, Your Majesty!”
“Alright, I’ll take you.”
“That’s a great choice, Your Majesty. You’ll never regret it!”
Goodbye to my self-esteem— A dog’s way to utmost power… that’s the route I’ll take! My second life will be as the Emperor’s adviser and potential successor.
Until the day of death!

25057.synopsis:
R-18 love at first sight!

25569.synopsis:

26337.synopsis:
Eutostea, Thebe’s third princess.
At night, a man appeared through her window and whispered in a honeyed voice, “I came to be your one-night lover. After tonight, you will not remember me, nor will we meet again.”
Who was he? Apollo, the god of prophecy. As a human being, who could resist a god?
“Princess of Thebes…” The man leaned against the window frame in pitch-black darkness with only the moonlight framing his stature.
And despite what he said, Apollo came to visit her again.
“Tomorrow, everyone throughout Greece will know that you are my woman.”
How long will their secret meeting last?
Aphelius, King of Thebes, blazing with shame flew to the Temple of Greece to confirm the identity of the suspicious man who went in and out of the third princess’ room. The three princesses were united as one to confirm the appearance of the man claiming to be the self-proclaimed god, Apollo.
While Eutostea hesitated for a moment, the hot candle melted and dripped on the shoulder of a god.
“You really don’t recognize me?”
“How do I know its you?”
Apollo grabbed her chin and brought his lips close to hers.
“Behold and open your heart, Princess of Thebes. Here lies the face you longed to see.”
He growled.

27873.synopsis:
A man who feels the pain of his lover after a blood transfusion :
The man (GyunHee), with a voice colder than the breath of winter, speaks to the woman(Sunny).
“Wait until I contact you again.”
But his car slips upon the wet road not long afterwards and crashes

Sunny shouts desperately for her boyfriend’s life as she arrives at the hospital.
“What is your blood type?” The doctor asks.
“…Pardon?”
He was in dire need for a blood transfusion, it was a common question but she could not answer.
After giving her blood to save her man, she decides their relationship wasn’t one of love and decides to leave him.
And as GyunHee wakes up a few days later…
He decides to chase after Sunny..
But what is this pain that he is feeling?

28129.synopsis: Song Yixiao, a lady of an official family, was miserably drowned to death due to the vicious scheme of her stepmother, after her parents divorced and respectively remarried. Coincidentally, she was resurrected and became her 8-year-old self. With grievance and ambition, Song Yixiao was determined to take revenge and live a different life. She plotted her own kidnapping in order to frame her stepmother for revenge. Afterwards, she moved to live with her birth mother, shunning from the previous fate of being drowned to death. By coincidence, Song Yixiao encountered a noble young man called Jian Xubai, Duke Yanguo, who was also unloved by his father and siblings just like her. As the wheel of fate rolled, their lives were linked and afterwards they got married. During the vicissitudes of dynasties, they supported each other through various hardships and games of thorn.

28641.synopsis:
The 24th century’s number one Pupillary master Luo Qingtong transmigrated into the body of the genius eldest miss whose cultivation had been destroyed.
Her cultivation tr*shed, her eyes blinded, and her status in her family snatched?

30689.synopsis:
Yu Sheng is born with a Crow Mouth. Nothing good he says comes true, whereas everything bad he says does.
In the last exam before summer vacation for his 2nd year of High School, “Troublemaker” Yu Sheng from the terrifying Central Third High jinxes himself into the place where the cream of the crop gathers — The Provincial Interhigh Summer Camp.

34785.synopsis:
There was once a treacherous concubine. She controlled the government, persecuted the honest and faithful, and created chaos in the harem. Inciting anger from the people.
Of course, in the end, the protagonist was cleanly dealt with and the people rejoiced.
Yuan Luo, who was supposed to be dead, wasn’t. Instead, she became the treacherous concubine who was comparable to Su Daji.
The first thought when she woke up was to whitewash her name. But…
Lackey 1: Niang niang, the family of imperial censor Zhu who impeached you has been slaughtered by us. Even his cats, dogs, chickens, and ducks have not been spared…

She walked out of her chamber and looked at the young general who was kneeling in the snow and begging for his family to be spared. She felt the eyes that fell on her grow colder and darker than the wind and snow.

35553.synopsis:
Sang Yu is a girl with yin-yang eyes. After a car accident at age eight, she began to see things that normal people could not – she would often speak to empty air, a faint smile on her face. This left an odd impression on others, and by the time she discovered her abnormality, she no longer had any friends.
By day, Mu Rong is the boss of a paper offerings shop, servicing the living to earn some cash and sustain her physical body.
By night, she is a death god representative, serving the Nether Palace, collecting yin merit in order to save her mother.
Because she had seen through life, death, and the cycle of reincarnation, Mu Rong has an indifferent nature, no friends, and does not participate in society.
One time, a difficult ghost escaped and attempted to destroy her corporeal body while Mu Rong’s spirit had left it vacant.

36577.synopsis:
After being framed by a close friend, the death row inmate Fu Yucheng was exiled to the Earth wastelands. One day, he picked up a dying boy in the desert—at that time, no one would have thought that this boy would become the frightening White Emperor.
Years later, in the deepest area of the Imperial Palace, the White Emperor, who was known for his indifference and cruelty, woke up every midnight with tears in his eyes, almost unable to breathe from the pain.

It’s a pity that Fu Yucheng, who was enjoying himself, still didn’t understand a truth comparable to Newton’s three major laws: Escaping death might be good for a while, but if your identity gets exposed you’re done for.

37857.synopsis:
On the day Lu Ranran was picked up by her biological parents, she suddenly obtained a system!

38369.synopsis:
I lived my whole life being used by other people and died at the age of 16. I thought it would be over like that, but when I opened my eyes again, I was back in the past. I thought I’d die while living the rest of my life in pain one more time.
But suddenly, a father who I had never seen before appeared before me. My dad, who I didn’t even know existed.
“When are you going to take away my powers?”
Dante’s eyes shook greatly at Ivanna’s words.
“Everyone did. You, when will you take it?”
“…I won’t.”
“Why?”
Ivanna couldn’t understand. Everyone coveted her power. Everyone wanted it, saying she was a sacrifice sent by God for humans.
 So why does he refuse?
“No one will take your power now. No one will bother you. I’ll protect you.”
“You’re trying to take my power.”
“I’m not.”
“Everyone said that and stole my power from me. They locked me up in prison.”

39393.synopsis:
It was a hero with dreams of unifying the continent that saved me, who was about to become an offering made to a monster.

39905.synopsis:
There was once a Bunny who became a high school teacher after successfully cultivating his human form.

No one knew that Shen Li, the fierce and ruthless guy from the village, secretly harbored a crush on He Yeqing. Until one day, his crush cornered him and said, “Marry me!”
Shen Li: “???”
Could such a good thing happen?

81377.synopsis:
“In ancient times, there was a gold-swallowing beast named Bai Wan. Bai Wan was unparalleled in brilliance, no one before or since has been able to match; Bai Wan was charming….”
“Speak human tongue.”
“Sh*t Shoveler, kiss me la!”
(Note: “Sh*t Shoveler” here refers to a person who cleans up after pets, such as a pet owner.)
?
Perspective: First-person narrative from the gold-swallowing beast; minimal emotional involvement.
Content tags: Sweet story

81633.synopsis:
My best friend of three years, whom I secretly have a crush on, had another fight with his girlfriend and wanted broke up again.
He came to me with beer and barbecue to vent: “If you were a girl, I’d definitely marry you!”
Before I could open my mouth, a gentle yet chilly voice sounded behind me: “You wouldn’t get the chance.”

82657.synopsis:
Since I regressed, I decided not to hide my abilities.
“Hypnosis, huh? That’s amazing! Hypnotize me too!”
“How about me, instead of that sly fox? If you join our clan… you, you can hypnotize me!”
…Maybe I exposed it too much.

83681.synopsis:
Contemporary college student Ye Leyao died suddenly from staying up late, and found himself transported into a world where several novels merged together, becoming the useless adopted son of the prestigious Huo family.
The good news is that, apart from him, everyone else in the family is a big shot. Eldest Brother Huo is a legendary figure in the business world, Second Brother Huo is a top actor in the entertainment industry, and Third Brother Huo is a skilled esports player and boss.
The bad news is, these big shots are all antagonists, and none of them have good endings.
Even worse news is that, upon waking up, he finds himself in the middle of a cheap romance involving Second Brother, who is oblivious to the fact that the child in his lover’s belly isn’t his seed at all!
Ye Leyao couldn’t help but scream inwardly: “Aaaaaahhhh—seriously? This romance-idiot still doesn’t know the child in his lover’s belly isn’t his?!”
All eyes in the family suddenly turn towards him. The second brother even stumbles.
Everyone: What?!
The top-tier Huo family adopted a young troublemaker some years ago.
Initially, nobody in the family paid him any mind. That is, until they could all hear Ye Leyao’s inner thoughts—
Just as Father Huo brings his down-and-out friend home.
Ye Leyao’s inner voice: “Oh, so this is the little seductress trying to seduce Father Huo, plotting to make Mother Huo and Father Huo divorce, and wrecking the Huo family?”
Father Huo’s pupils dilate: “!” 
That night, before Ye Leyao can subtly hint to Mother Huo, the little seductress is personally “thrown” out by Father Huo.
During breakfast at home, Eldest Brother Huo takes a video call discussing crucial shipment matters with his assistant.
Ye Leyao perks up his ears, muttering to himself: “Why do I vaguely remember a typhoon changing course to pass through this route in a few days? Big Brother’s business deal is definitely going down.”
Eldest Brother Huo: “…” 
He immediately changes the shipping route with his assistant. Sure enough, five days later, news came that the original route was hit by a typhoon.
Afterwards, Eldest Brother Huo transfers five million into Ye Leyao’s account. Ye Leyao is astonished. 
Eldest Brother Huo tries to remain composed, saying calmly, “Take it, you’ve earned it.”
Third Brother Huo isn’t home often. After the league ends, he brings his newly recruited team members home for dinner. Just as they enter the house, Ye Leyao stares keenly at his new teammates.
Third Brother Huo is about to warn Ye Leyao against premature romance, when he hears Ye Leyao whispering in his mind: “They’re handsome alright, but unfortunately, they’re moles sent by the rival team.”
Third Brother Huo: “!!!” 
That night, Third Brother Huo begins investigating and not only discovers that the new teammates are moles from the rival team, but also finds out that his most trusted assistant has been secretly gathering data on their team!
A week later, another ten million appeared in Ye Leyao’s account.
Ye Leyao, holding the money happily: “Third Brother, you’re more generous than Big Brother!”
Just then, Eldest Brother Huo passes by: “…”
As a supporting character in the novel, Ye Leyao’s biggest dream is to save up money and flee with his family of antagonists when they hit rock bottom. Little did he expect that all these villains in his family would not only avoid disaster but thrive in their careers, and he would end up soaring with them.
associated_names: After the Supporting Character’s Inner Thoughts Were Exposed, the Villain’s Entire Family Spoiled Him
Sau Khi Tiếng Lòng Của Người Qua Đường Giáp Bị Lộ Được Cả Gia Đình Kẻ Phản Diện Đoàn Sủng
路人甲心声泄露后被反派全家团宠了
路人甲心聲泄露後被反派全家團寵了

84705.synopsis:
The sole survivor of the ‘Final Expedition.’
Commander of the Samael House’s Crazy Mage Squad, the Crazy Mage Ruin.
After a harrowing expedition, he defeated the Demon King and met his end.
Only to wake up 300 years later.
Reborn as a descendant of the accursed yet beloved ‘Samael House.’
The most powerful family on the damned continent.
associated_names: The Catastrophic Crazy Magician Reincarnated into a Fallen Noble Family

84961.synopsis:
My duke husband, who was a disappointment except for his fantastic face and appearance, changed one day.
At first, he seemed not to recognize me, but suddenly, he became amazing in bed, a flirting genius, a social expert, and could do anything perfectly!
One night, after being tormented to the point of exhaustion, I finally asked tearfully.
“Um, are you really my husband? You’re not, right? There’s no way. There’s no way you could be this good…”
“How did you know, my lady? Hah, I didn’t think my true identity would be revealed this soon.”
What?
It turns out, my munchkin husband was actually the male lead from a web novel who had possessed an extra character.

86241.synopsis:
While scrolling through her social media feed, Su Jinshi accidentally became bound to a romance game system. Before she knew it, she found herself raising Shen Shilang, the son of a former Prime Minister whose family had been eliminated.
When Shen Shilang was injured and needed medicine.
Su Jinshi: “Buy!”
When Shen Shilang’s meals lacked nutrition.
Su Jinshi: “Buy!”
When Shen Shilang had no new clothes.
Su Jinshi: “Buy!”
Watching these items materialize from thin air, Shen Shilang frowned. “Who dares play such supernatural tricks?”
Su Jinshi: “How rude. Address me as ‘Master.'”
Shen Shilang: “Heh.”
Later, Shen Shilang lay on the bed, face flushed as he clutched his collar. “Master, stop touching me.”
Throughout his life, Shen Shilang had despised all talk of ghosts and spirits. Yet ironically, during his darkest days, his only companion was a “female ghost.”
When others slandered him, she believed in him.
When he was besieged, she protected him.
When he was poisoned, she saved him.
He never imagined there would come a day when he would kneel at every temple in Great Xi, willing to sacrifice his own blood just for the chance to see her once more.
Until—
Su Jinshi spent a fortune in the system’s store to purchase a teleportation gate, transporting herself directly into Shen Shilang’s arms.
Shen Shilang loosened his collar: “Go on, touch me. Why’d you stop?”
associated_names: 氪金养到真权臣后，她被反撩了

87009.synopsis:
Fu Ran, my rival, and I were friends with benefits, in the literal sense.
He had skin hunger, and I suffered from pheromone imbalance, so we both needed an Alpha or Omega to soothe us.
Recently, his white moonlight from abroad returned.
Who doesn’t have an unrequited love these days?
I turned to comfort my heartbroken childhood friend instead.
At night, after getting drunk, just as I was about to take things further, the door was kicked open.
“Luo Jiu An, are you cheating on me behind my back?”
associated_names: 死对头的白月光回国了

87521.synopsis:
Whenever Sa Junmok goes on a picnic, the bus always breaks down. When he travels, the hotel always has a blackout. Even when he eats group meals, he’s the only one who gets food poisoning. As an unlucky omega, this is Junmok’s everyday life. Despite his bad luck, he decided to experience all the things he missed out on once he entered college, including having a passionate romance with a handsome and charming alpha!
However, his inherent bad luck didn’t improve just because he got into a prestigious university. Things get even more complicated when he gets involved with the campus celebrity, Gong Jurim, who seems to make everything worse. Although Gong Jurim is the perfect alpha who embodies Junmok’s ideal type, every time they meet, it ends in disaster. Junmok resolves to avoid him at all costs.
“I know I’ve done a lot wrong, but let’s stop seeing each other because I’m bad luck.”
“Why, because you feel guilty for causing trouble?”
“That’s part of it, but… Gongju sunbaenim, you’re bad for my heart.”
However, after a night of drinking, Junmok wakes up to find himself in bed with Gong Jurim, who is inexplicably naked.
“You said I was your type. My face, my body, even my voice.”
“Gongju-nim?”
“You have to take responsibility for your confession.”
Can the unlucky Junmok find happiness in a relationship with the infamous Gong Jurim? Princess, please take away my misfortune!

88033.synopsis:
In a world inspired by Chinese culture, a boy named Kou Tenhou (Huang Tianfang) lives his life. He meets a girl brought by his father and suddenly recalls that he is in the world of a game.
The game——”History of Swordmaster”——is a Chinese fantasy setting where Kou Tenhou is fated to be destroyed by heroes as the “World’s Greatest Villain.”
The reason Kou Tenhou becomes a great villain is linked to the girl brought by his father. Her name is Ryuu Seirei (Liu Xingrei). As she grows, Seirei enters the royal harem, becomes the king’s favorite, and turns into a villain. Her stepbrother, Kou Tenhou, is destined to rise to power and head straight for the “Kou Tenhou Destruction End.”
The game starts 10 years from now, and Kou Tenhou must avoid this destruction end.
To prevent his stepsister from becoming a villain, Kou Tenhou decides to cherish her. Additionally, he plans to acquire an “Escape Skill” for emergencies.
As he continues his training, Kou Tenhou gains his stepsister’s love and meets close friends. Eventually, Kou Tenhou masters martial arts and becomes a significant figure in the country.
This is the story of a boy who avoids the destruction end and grows into a beloved great hero.
associated_names: Tenka no dai akunin ni tensei shita shōnen, hito tarashi no dai eiyū ni naru - keikoku no bishōjo-tachi to, eiyū gundan o tsukurimasu -
天下の大悪人に転生した少年、人たらしの大英雄になる　-傾国の美少女たちと、英雄軍団を作ります-

88289.synopsis:
‘Just kill them instead of torturing them endlessly.’
I used to wholeheartedly agree with that statement…
Until I became the heroine of the regret, devastation, and obsession story myself.
associated_names: I Won't Become a RAO Heroine!
I Won't Become a Regret, Angst, and Obsession Heroine!

88545.synopsis:
Minazuki Haruto has had terrible luck with women since he was young.
It all started with a near-kidnapping during his kindergarten years, followed by being falsely accused by girls in elementary school, and then losing his mother in a traffic accident on the way home from an amusement park trip meant to cheer him up.
Despite his grief, he continued to act for the sake of others, following the words his mother left behind. However, he was branded a hypocrite and ab*sed by the cruel woman who took him in. He continued to suffer a full house of misfortune with women, including false confessions and stalkers.
Nothing went well, and he was betrayed by women day after day. This day was no different—his childhood friend, whom he was dating, told him, “I found someone else I like,” and broke up with him…
—From that day forward, Haruto, realizing his mistakes, sets out to make the girls he had hurt understand! …But for some reason, the girls he thought he had made understand began to pursue him even more aggressively!?
associated_names: 女難の俺がわからせた美少女達は、激重感情に目覚めて離してくれなくなった

89569.synopsis:
Argent, the Guardian Knight of the third Princess is bewildered when Princess Pacian (7 Years Old), whose engagement was broken off, tells him.
“I am going to become an adventurer.”
The princess takes out the magic tools used by the Former Hero and sets off on an adventure with one knight.
“Princess, please tell your father to raise my salary. Also, please give me more guards~”
He pleads but…
The new guards and maid candidates have their own reasons and on top of that, they start scouting “companions for the hero” along the way –?
When Argent realizes the meaning of the journey, he finally makes up his mind!
associated_names: やんちゃ姫さまの大冒険 うちの第三王女、冒険者になるってよ（web版）

90337.synopsis:
Knights uphold justice, while wizards pursue truth.
Helag, leveraging the gene chip from his previous life, embarks on the path of seeking truth.

90593.synopsis:
I installed the DLC for a turn-based roguelike game, where even with 3,000 hours of playtime, you never know when you’ll be wiped out. I set it to the highest difficulty, but when I opened my eyes, I was inside the Game.
I have to clear it. To survive.
associated_names: I Fell into the Highest-Difficulty Dungeon

90849.synopsis:
On the day of his high school entrance ceremony, Samejima Kingo was dumped by his girlfriend, Yagi Saki, because she fell in love with Matsukubo Takuma, whom she met for the first time.
On the other hand, Kumagai Yuri was also dumped by her boyfriend, Matsukubo Takuma, because he fell in love at first sight.
This is the story of those two people.
*It will be quite a while before the childhood friends get hurt badly.
*Fun high school life begins in episode 5.
associated_names: 高校の入学式の日、幼なじみの恋人から、運命の人と出会ったから別れてくれって フラれた俺たちの話。

91361.synopsis:
In a dazzling world where every individual has the chance to become a creator, Su Bai embarks on an extraordinary adventure. As he reaches adulthood, he discovers that each person receives a single opportunity to cultivate a seed of a new world. Some soar to incredible heights, crafting realms filled with mechanical marvels, while others tragically fail, facing explosive disasters that lead to their demise. At a pivotal moment, Su Bai awakens a formidable God Simulator, granting him the power to foresee and influence the future of his world with endless possibilities. This simulator unveils a host of extraordinary divine talents that can alter the course of existence:
With the Behemoth Enhancement, he can magnify the size of living beings, unleashing rare and colossal creatures upon the land. The Civilization Flame ignites the intelligence of beings, birthing advanced civilizations that push the boundaries of knowledge. The Intelligent Machinery Ascendance talent offers machines the potential for self-awareness, blurring the lines between life and technology. Through Mythical Synthesis, Su Bai can fuse materials to create legendary life forms, each with its unique abilities. As he navigates the trials of creation and the responsibilities of leadership, Su Bai must build alliances, confront rivals, and unlock the mysteries of the universe. Each choice he makes shapes not only his destiny but the fate of an entire world teetering between wonder and chaos. Will Su Bai rise as the ultimate creator, or will he succumb to the challenges that lie ahead? This exhilarating tale is a journey of ambition, strategy, and the relentless pursuit of power in a world where anything is possible.
associated_names: 全民创世：开局一个上帝模拟器！

92385.synopsis:
A woman must be well-versed in music, singing, painting, dancing, and modern languages. Her appearance, posture, voice, tone, and manner of speaking must all possess a certain quality. In addition to all of this, she should have some real knowledge, read more books, and increase her wisdom.
This is Darcy’s idea of a perfect woman (excerpt from the original work).
Now, imagine an ancient noble princess from the past suddenly inhabiting Mary’s body. How would Darcy  react to his ideal woman standing before him?
Author has something to say: Some might say that my female lead is a bit “overpowered,” but I can only respond that music, chess, calligraphy, painting, needlework, and etiquette were essential skills for noblewomen in ancient times. It would be odd if she didn’t know anything!
Alright, after several days of cramming, I admit that this story is a bit of a self-indulgent fantasy with an all-powerful heroine. If you can’t handle that, now’s your chance to escape! I’m going to enjoy finishing this off with no regrets! (Thunder strikes! The rain’s starting! Time to run home and bring in the laundry!)
associated_names: 傲慢与偏见之贫穷贵公主

94689.synopsis:
Lin Yihuan suddenly finds herself transformed into the daughter of a prime minister. Her father is convicted, her elder brother exiled, and she and her young brother are demoted to commoners.  
She pats her younger brother’s head: “Don’t be afraid; your sister will take care of you!”  
Half a month later, a dessert shop opens in Shengjing.  
Gossiping onlookers: “A shop opened by the daughter of a criminal official? We mustn’t go! Absolutely not… Huh? What’s that heavenly smell?”  
Later—  
Gossiping onlookers: “Just one sip of the wine she brews, and it’ll haunt your dreams—you won’t be able to sleep!”  
Lin Yihuan: “Coffee, buy one get one free.”  
Noblewomen: “Only the soufflé from the dessert shop can truly reflect our status.”  
Lin Yihuan: “Got it! I’ll deliver it to your residence shortly.”  
Young gentlemen of the capital: “The drinks from the dessert shop are sweet, but the proprietress is even sweeter!”  
Lin Yihuan: “Sir, would you like to sign up for a membership? It includes free refills~”  
*****
The dessert shop becomes wildly popular, attracting even the capital’s most notorious playboy, Liu Hexiao, who strolls in twirling a folding fan.  
Liu Hexiao is the second son of a prince. Arrogant and lawless since childhood, he’s a devil feared by all! Even the emperor finds him a headache.  
Gossiping crowd, furious but too afraid to speak up: “It’s over! The proprietress is surely going to be harassed! What a wonderful young woman she was…”  
But to everyone’s shock, Liu Hexiao tosses aside his folding fan, silently ties on a small apron, grabs a menu, walks to a dining table, and says,“What would you like to eat, dear guest?”  
Gossiping crowd, trembling in fear: “What’s going on with the shizi?!?”  
Liu Hexiao, rolling his eyes: “I’m the male boss— the live-in son-in-law type.”  
*****
One-Sentence Summary:
“You’re amazing—sweet, but not cloying.”  
Core Theme:
Starting from scratch, achieving prosperity through culinary talent
Reading Tips:
1. The female lead is soft, adorable, and lovable. The male lead is domineering yet fiercely protective. High, high, high sugar content~
2. This story is set in a fictional world, one very, very detached from reality. It’s full of personal creative liberties. If you don’t like it, don’t read it.
3. Add this to your favorites. It’ll genuinely make you feel good.

95969.synopsis:
Cao Sheng, a washed-up web novel author, finds himself transported back to 1997. In this year, web novels have yet to emerge, giving him the chance to become their founding father.
Seizing the opportunity, he writes a novel and posts it online, thus ushering in the era of web novels. Through his works, he repeatedly shows everyone—this is how web novels can be written!

96225.synopsis:
As someone working in the animation industry, Mu Suxing unexpectedly binds with a Master Animation Development System and takes over an animation studio on the verge of bankruptcy. With debts piling up, he decides, “Let me first create some brainless commercial animation to make some money.”
When the animation is first released, it receives pointed criticism from industry insiders: “Vulgar! Superficial! What on earth is this?”
However, after the animation achieves legendary sales in the industry, everyone is left speechless: “This actually works?”
Yet, when much of the animation world turns green with envy and starts churning out mindless, cute harem anime, industry bigwigs lament the state of the industry, and Mu Suxing smiles as he reveals titles like “Demon Slayer,” “Your Lie in April,” and “Detective Conan”…
Industry peers: “???”
Many years later, an unnamed animation producer confesses that Mu Suxing is the person he hates most in this world because—
“He led a large part of the industry into the ditch with his mediocre, sales-driven animation, and then he walked away without a second glance.”

97249.synopsis:
【Funny + Raising Kids + Group Pet + 1v1 + Both Pure + Female Lead Meets CP Lu Jinghuai After Adulthood】
【Funny Little Sun with 800 Schemes Beneath Her Cheerful Exterior x Holy Beauty with a Sinister and Cunning Nature Beneath His Saintly Appearance】
Nian Nian found herself transported into a group pet novel, becoming the despised biological daughter of her foster father, who wields immense power. Her birth was steeped in conspiracy, a bloodline tainted by a wicked family.
In the original story, due to jealousy over the female lead effortlessly receiving all the affection, she commits a grave mistake, provoking her furious father to expel her from the Ji family. Eventually, she is treacherously plotted against by the male lead and dies a tragic death.
Nian Nian thinks: Who says this book is old? The plot is fantastic, with excitement hitting the roof!
To survive, she decides to cling to the unpredictable and temperamental father’s thigh. When the female lead arrives, whoever wants to be the Ji family’s eldest daughter can have it; she’s saving up to run away.
Little did she expect, this cling turned into a decade-long affair. By the time she wanted to escape, those around her weren’t willing anymore. Under Nian Nian’s influence, the cold-hearted father learns to love, the future male lead who was supposed to have eight children with the female lead becomes indifferent, and even a future major antagonist is willing to be the third wheel, humbly submitting for love.
A group of side characters with severe childhood traumas find their body bags (figuratively, their lives) becoming warm and fuzzy.
“Mr. Ji, the eldest young lady has been gone for three days.”
“Has she admitted her mistake?”
“No, she’s been spreading rumors outside that you can poop three tons at once.”
Father: “…………”
associated_names: 略施癫计，懂爱后渣爹刀拿不稳了

101089.synopsis:
Living life as an unattached person vs. getting TS and winning.
I chose the latter.
associated_names: TS 당하면 반응속도가 올라가는 건 상식이잖아요?

104673.synopsis:
Shi Niannian woke up and dreamed that she was the original wife of the male protagonist in the period novel.
In the dream, she abandoned her husband and children and ended up in a miserable situation, while the male protagonist was successful in his career.
After waking up from the dream, she was still on the road to escape. Facing the male protagonist who came to chase her, Shi Niannian had two choices:
1. Leave the male protagonist and continue to run away.
2. Go home with the male protagonist.
However, before she could make a choice, the male protagonist came directly and took her home.
Shi Niannian: “…”
—-
Liang Muchuan has a bright future and is indifferent and cold.
He always knew that his wife was coquettish and had some minor problems, but he never thought that one day she would dare to abandon her husband and children.
Liang Muchuan laughed angrily.
Everyone in the family compound thought that Shi Niannian and Liang Muchuan would not be together for long, as one was serious and the other was very coquettish.
But later…
associated_names: 年代文男主的嬌氣原配

104929.synopsis:
Why did I suddenly possess the bully in the novel….
And a person I never bullied is taking revenge on me..
But something about this revenge seems strange?

107233.synopsis:
“…I’m sorry. She is my destiny.”
—Felicia’s fiancé’s destiny was not her.
“As you already know, she is frail. She cannot fulfill the duties of a queen. That’s why, Felicia, I want you to support her. As queen, I want you to help her—your older sister, who will become the second consort.”
When her fiancé told her this—
(Huh? No way. Absolutely not…!)
At that moment, she regained memories of her past life.
She locked herself in her room for five days.
And the answer she came up with was breaking off the engagement.
Enough of this!
Determined to confront her father, even at the risk of being disowned, she stepped out of her room—only to be utterly shocked.
Because due to the effects of regaining her past-life memories, her magic had gone out of control.
Outside her room, it had not been five days—but five hundred years.
Thus, Felicia’s second life began.
associated_names: お姉様に恋した、私の婚約者。5日間部屋に篭っていたら500年が経過していました。

107745.synopsis:
I was pulled into a souls-like game and returned.
As with most reincarnators, I became overwhelmingly powerful—but what’s the point?
My friends, my family, my lover.
They’re all gone.
associated_names: I Became a Flaw in the Flawless Soulslike Game (Novelpia Global)
It became a flaw that was not present in the Soul-like game.
소울라이크 게임 속 없었던 옥의 티가 되었다

108001.synopsis:
For some reason, all of the idols Sakurai Akito supported were at the bottom of the popularity rankings, so everyday he would engage in “Oshi activity”. Whenever there was an event for his idols, he would attend and whisper his love (as an oshi) to his idols.
Akito is the type of person who makes a clear distinction between his activities and reality. He is not in love with his oshi, but his idols are apparently not like that…
associated_names: アイドル人気ランキング最下位厨、黙って応援し続けていたらいつの間にか修羅場になっていた件

108769.synopsis:
It kinda feels like I’ve entered a game world or something…
But I skipped through the whole story, so all I remember are the items.
Ah, I’m screwed.

110561.synopsis:
Supernatural forces are awakening.
Horrors and bizarre anomalies are eroding reality itself.
Watch how our protagonist, reincarnated as a beautiful girl, struggles to survive—
dodging the twisted claws of lustful anomalies and ferocious vengeful spirits!
“That’s it? Get lost, you clown!”
The girl clutched the urn and spewed curses with flair.
associated_names: An Unusual Life Starting with Evil Spirits
从恶灵开始的非日常生活

112609.synopsis:
Before graduating from univerity, Bian Yingning died in an accident, just a hair’s breadth away from receiving the diploma she’d worked towards for over a decade.
What could she do? She could only listen to this system that appeared out of nowhere, completing tasks and accumulating points to return to her original world.
In the book she’d been transported into, the female and male leads had a torturous love story spanning a thousand chapters, filled with countless female supporting characters who threw themselves at the wealthy male lead.
Bian Yingning’s mission was to prevent these obstacles in the main couple’s love story—the cannon fodder female supporting characters—from sacrificing themselves for the male lead.
associated_names: 穿进虐文里做画饼大师

113633.synopsis:
As everyone knows, there are three kinds of mages:
Mages who cast spells using intelligent assistance
Mages who only know how to apply spell structures by rote
Mages who pry open the elements with knowledge and mana—the true Archmages
Then what about artistic conception and mages?
“Luo Wenyi, you’re not worthy of being called a mage! Artistic conception? Artistic conception?! Just the delusional self-flattery of some crude warrior!”
“But… existence is reason enough.”
“You’re a disgrace to all mages!”
“Oh? You don’t even have the right to define me.”
“You—!”
…
My name is Chen Yi. You can also call me Luo Wenyi.
Just an ordinary fire-type mage.
associated_names: 来自游戏世界的火系法爷

114401.synopsis:
“Dad, you’ve been awfully chummy with Ren-kun from next door lately,” Hana Tanaka observed, her eyes narrowed at her father, Kenji Tanaka, who stubbornly was still in her Magical Girl Black outfit.
“Ah, Hana-chan! Well, Dad and Ren-kun were just… discussing your future marriage prospects with him!” Black stammered, a bead of sweat forming under her bangs.
“Still in that ridiculous getup, Dad? And why haven’t you changed back for days? The neighbors are starting to give us looks!”
“A Magical Girl must always be vigilant against the encroaching Evil Organization threatening our beloved city!”
“Enough excuses! Tell me the truth, Dad!” Hana demanded, hands on her hips.
After a long long while of silent, Black sighed, “Hana, my dearest daughter… your dear Okaasan, before she passed, wished for my happiness. And Ren-kun… he’s just like her. So gentle, so kind! It must be her, reincarnated as a boy! This magical power, this frilly costume… it was all granted so I could be with her again!”
Hana recoiled. “Dad, that’s… that’s completely ridiculous! You can’t actually be planning to marry him!”
“And why shouldn’t your Dad find a little joy?!” Black fumed, cheeks flushing, “Don’t you understand the first thing about filial piety?! One more word of your youthful impertinence, and Ren-kun will be your new step-father by sunset!”
“You crazy old fool! So that was your twisted plan all along! Fine! If it’s a battle you desire, then a battle you shall receive! Only one Tanaka is walking out of this living room alive!”
“Prepare yourself! Witness my ultimate technique! God-Severing Cleave!!”

114657.synopsis:
My roommate joined a VTuber agency.
They asked me to come along for a meeting about security, and I tagged along without thinking too much…
“Would you like to try streaming?”
…And just like that, I got scouted.

127457.synopsis:
Chu He transmigrated into a novel.
[That villain will kill the male lead, cripple the female lead, and eventually end his own life in despair. This world is on the verge of collapse, and your task is to save it.] 
The useless system dumped the mission and vanished before Chu He could even figure out what to do. To make matters worse, she was kidnapped to Miaojiang and became the perfect vessel for the poison masters to cultivate their Gu.
Poison vessels were not human—they remembered nothing of their past.
The mother Gu was precious, and only the last survivor of the bloody struggle had the right to claim her.
Moments later, the ground was littered with corpses.
A white-haired youth in bloodstained robes stepped forward, his path lined with venomous Gu insects watching hungrily.
Chu He clenched her teeth and blurted out a lie: “You can’t kill me—I’m already carrying your child!”
The youth paused, tilting his head slightly.
Half a year later, the system finally reconnected and resumed its explanation.
[Listen up, the reason that villain is so insane and twisted is because he was raised as a poison vessel, fed on Gu toxins since childhood. He lacks normal human emotions, and he—] 
“Is obsessive and relentless, never stopping until he gets what he wants.”
The system hesitated. [How did you know that?] 
Chu He lay weakly on the bed, her voice drained of hope. “It all goes back to the day I spoke without thinking…”
The door creaked open, letting in a sliver of light.
The youth approached with the soft chime of silver ornaments, bending down until his crimson eyes locked onto her face. His whisper was tender yet chilling. “Ah He, today is another day for us to work hard… to bring Little Treasure into the world.”
The system: [Who is Little Treasure?] 
Chu He huddled in the corner, clutching the blankets as chains rattled nearby. She wanted to cry but had no tears left.
—Of course, it was the child she owed him!
associated_names: 穿书后意外攻略了苗疆少年

128225.synopsis:
Gu Yi transmigrated and woke up in the middle of a su*cide attempt. After narrowly clinging to life, she felt as if she had entered paradise compared to her former world, where modern pollution had plagued her existence.
But paradise wasn’t without hardships—her Mother was frail, her younger siblings were still children, the sea was perilous with sudden typhoons and storms, and she herself could not swim. On top of that, troublesome relatives constantly made things difficult.
Fortunately, Gu Yi was an exceptionally skilled physician. Healing the sick and saving lives earned her the villagers’ respect. With her Mother and siblings by her side, she began foraging along the shore and casting nets at sea. Relying on her golden cheat—being able to breathe underwater—she caught large fish to sell at high prices, salvaged shipwrecks for hidden treasures, and gradually amassed a vast fortune, rising to become a true overlord of the seas.
One day, she fished up a handsome man. Thinking him a fellow townsman, she was caught off guard to discover he was, in fact, a shrewd and ambitious royal prince with deep schemes.
Furious at his deception, Gu Yi broke things off. But the man pursued her relentlessly:
“You once said you wished to see every corner of this world. Then I shall conquer it, and take you to witness it all.”
associated_names: 穿成流放渔女，赶海发家撩暴君

132577.synopsis:
Zhu Shuangjiang is a university student about to graduate. One day, she suddenly time-traveled back thirty years.
Turned into a child, she was left on the street and eventually ended up being sent to a welfare institute. At the welfare institute, her basic survival was guaranteed, but there was no such thing as a free life. After much thought, the most reliable path left to her was actually only one—studying hard.
Content Tags: Time Travel, Rebirth, Era Novel, Growth, Daily Life, Top Student
One-Sentence Summary: A time-travel with a shrunken body
Theme/Message: The world is so full of wonders, why torment yourself so much?

137953.synopsis:
One day, I suddenly realized that I was a villainess in a novel.
Including the fact that the person I had been obsessed with all this time would end up killing me in the future.
“Everything is easy for me. Even letting you go like this.”
So I only tried to let him go in a hurry, but……
“…Ugh.” Woohyun slowly began to undo his buttons one by one with one hand.
“You… you’re acting strange. Come to your senses, Woohyun.”
“Don’t run away.” His eyes were crazed like someone who had broken somewhere inside.
His hot breath tickled my nape.
“Guide me.”
As the distance between us gradually closed, I finally felt our lips overlapping and thought:
This has really gone terribly wrong.

152801.synopsis:
I woke up to find the world completely transformed.
I had traveled back in time from the year 2013 in the normal human timeline to 1994’s “everyone’s a Witch” timeline.
“Perhaps there are no Witches in the world—or perhaps everyone is a Witch.”

155105.synopsis:
Yan Hui is naturally gay, yet she was unfortunately bound to a system and forced to become the “cannon fodder female supporting character” in every world. For ages, she had to suppress her disgust to complete cliché missions: seducing the Male Lead and bullying the Female Lead.
Eventually, Yan Hui snapped. She began to strike back at the God of the System (Main God), interfering with the system’s core programming. In her subsequent mission worlds, she launched a campaign of revenge, frantically sabotaging the main plotlines.
World 1: Yan Hui becomes a “drama queen” idol, brazenly snatching the Female Lead away right under the Male Lead’s nose.
World 2: Yan Hui becomes an arrogant Imperial Concubine, stirring up chaotic drama in the Male Lead’s harem with total composure.
World 3: Yan Hui becomes an unscrupulous school bully, openly stealing the “School Beauty” whom the Male Lead has crushed on for years.
World N…
For violating the laws of the worlds, all of Yan Hui’s points were deducted, and she was locked in a “small dark room” by the Main God for punishment.
Bound hand and foot, Yan Hui sneered coldly, “I bet your gun… cough… I bet you don’t dare kill me!”
The Main God looked at her with a tender, doting smile: “Who said I was going to kill you?”
Yan Hui: “…”
Important Note!!! Yan Hui is not a “good person”! Anyone who has been exploited and tortured by a system for over a thousand missions is lucky not to have gone completely insane or destroyed the world. Consequently, in the first world, Yan Hui is a bit of a “mad dog”—she doesn’t care about anyone else’s feelings and is only focused on her own amusement.
Short Summary:
I’ll outlive the System!
I’ll steal the Female Lead from the Male Lead!
Male Lead (fuming): “You woman! To get my attention, you actually stooped to this?!”
Yan Hui (hugging the Female Lead with a wicked smirk): “What can I say? She seems to like me better. Right, darling?”
Female Lead (blushing): “Mhm, I like you the most!”
associated_names: 男主，放开那个女主，让我来（快穿）

158433.synopsis:
Du Tianle transmigrated to a world of cultivation. 
Not only did his lifespan increase daily, but he could also plunder lifespan by killing demons, monsters, ghosts, and ghouls. 
This lifespan could then be infused into Cultivation Methods to gain corresponding cultivation effects. 
With such a heaven-defying System, Du Tianle would kill any opponent he could defeat on the spot, and if he couldn’t win, he would lie low first, then seek revenge after a couple of months. 
He can be aggressive and he can be cautious, so are you afraid!

170209.synopsis:
My beautiful genius student is closing in on me, trying to create a fait accompli…?

Satoru Fuyutsuki, a teacher at an academy where geniuses from various fields gather, receives a heartfelt confession from Kusuri Yakushiji, a genius girl majoring in pharmacology who has loved him since childhood. However, he rejects her, citing their age difference as the reason.
The next morning, Satoru wakes up to find his body rejuvenated to the same age as Kusuri’s!?
“Now we can flirt without worrying about the age gap, right…?”
Deciding that if their age difference was in the way, she just needed to get rid of it, Kusuri had slipped Satoru a drug she formulated herself!
With the obstacle gone, Kusuri aggressively pushes her advances on him. However, having zero romantic experience, she gets terribly embarrassed at the most crucial moments…?
A forced-rejuvenation, frustratingly sweet rom-com where a beautiful genius student aggressively pursues her teacher!

Aiba Hashiru was a Hero summoned to another world. After dealing with some unforeseen trouble following the Demon Lord’s defeat, Hashiru managed to return to his original world—with all his Hero abilities intact—to resume his life as a rookie teacher.

220897.synopsis:
When memories of another life awaken, Mu Yi discovers he is living inside the lethal cultivation world of A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality – and the Myriad Treasure Catalog has awakened with him. The catalog can record any treasure he encounters, decipher its forging method, and adapt legendary artifacts from myth into weakened replicas the mortal realm can actually sustain. An Earth Deity Seal becomes a hidden map and a source of refined materials. An Eight Trigrams Furnace can transform his craft. Beyond them wait treasures that should be impossible for a low-level cultivator even to name.
Mu Yi has useful foreknowledge, but no invincible cultivation talent, powerful clan, or limitless resources. To avoid becoming collateral in sect rivalries and the approaching demonic war, he must win a place among stronger cultivators, turn cheap materials into priceless advantages, survive deadly trials, and conceal the true reach of his catalog. Every successful replica gives him another way to cheat death – and another reason for the cultivation world to notice him. In a realm where immortality belongs to the ruthless, Mu Yi will copy the wonders of heaven and forge a path no mortal was meant to walk.
